notes.title: Update is coming
notes.notes: [p]1 month later, I am here with the first update. in this update, I made changes that will make the theme of the game a little more enlightened, increase the forest feeling, improvements in the direction of woodcutting, changes in the tree visuals according to the life levels when cutting trees, and changes that will make it fun to play this kind of game. I told you that the game will not only have a theme on wood and wood, for this I first added stones to the game (you cannot actively break it now, but in the next updates I will activate it with the products that are produced with stones and the machines that will make them, and I am also working on an improvable pickaxe system for breaking stones).[/p][p][/p][p]your feedback directly affects the direction of the game, so you can send me your feedback via discord, email or steam community.[/p]

notes.title: New Language Update Now Available for Forest Factory!
notes.notes:
[b]New Language Update Now Available for Forest Factory![/b]

We’re thrilled to announce a major update for Forest Factory, bringing a more inclusive experience to players worldwide with the addition of new language options!

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]





Expanded Language Support: The game now includes [b]Simplified Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish[/b], alongside the original [b]English[/b] version.



Improved Accessibility: Reach more players in their native languages for a seamless and immersive experience.

[h2]Why This Matters[/h2]

This update reflects our commitment to making [b]Forest Factory[/b] accessible to a global audience. Whether you’re a new player or a returning fan, you can now enjoy the game in your preferred language!

[h2]Get Involved[/h2]





Try the new language options and let us know your feedback!



Share the update with friends to spread the word.

Thank you for your continued support. Dive in and experience Forest Factory in a whole new way!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Head Lamp[/h2]
A headlamp was added because it was very dark at night. You can turn it on and off with the [b]"P"[/b] key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576870/59379531ccbca6f8ad2f80072c175a8ab7579088.jpg[/img]


[h2]Dragging items[/h2]
It was quite annoying not being able to rotate the items as you wanted while dragging them. This problem is now gone. You can switch a dragged object to rotation change mode by pressing the r key, and you can adjust its rotation with the [b]"T"[/b] and [b]"Y"[/b] keys.


[b]Peeling machine[/b]
You can use the right mouse button to repair the peeling machine. Sound is now played while it is being repaired, so you can tell that you have repaired it. I also fixed the error that occurred when putting too much wood into the machine.


[b]Woodshed[/b]
I observed that players put their wood in the places I created for placing machines in the warehouse. So I placed the woodshed inside the warehouse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576870/213b0ecf07b8d16a997048a2a083d1155eefcd43.jpg[/img]



[b]Inventory[/b]
When you want to throw an item in your inventory to the ground, the next slot is now selected. This way, you can throw your wood to the ground very quickly.

When you load a saved game, if you have wood in your inventory, you may have observed that when you want to pick up the wood, it cannot resist gravity. I have solved this problem. Now loading a saved game does not cause a problem.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed interface problems that occur on different types of screen scales
A system that is easier and more enjoyable to manage has been adopted for changing the location of machines,
an arrangement has been made to prevent people who do not want to do tutorials or who already know the game from doing tasks over and over again.
A function has been added to the exit button in the main menu and errors that occur when deleting your records have been corrected.
The menu used to buy axes and seeds has been updated to a simpler and more game-appropriate appearance.
A simpler and easier-to-understand interface has been made in the marketplace menu.

There are many more minor changes, but these are the important ones.
I would like to inform you that more than 10 languages ​​will be supported very soon.
A new town that will direct the course of the game, new machines and new products for production will be added.
You can reach me from the discord or steam community for problems you encounter in the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576870/bbe4283e0dd75ba0fe6920cb321aa37e93b8ae07.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Changes in Forest Factory
notes.notes:
[b]Machine/Item Purchase Update[/b]

I’m working on a new update that changes how players purchase machines and other items in my game. Instead of going to a market, players will now be able to buy any item they want at any time. With this update, pressing the "B" key will allow players to select and purchase the machine or item they wish to build, as long as they have enough money. Once purchased, the machine or item will spawn directly at the player’s current location, ready to be used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576870/2b4cfa612a35aa76585e7a4db46855950c761682.jpg[/img]

[b]Positioning of Machines and Platforms[/b]
Connecting machines together is now much easier and faster with a snap system. If you’d prefer to disable the snap system, I’ve added an option for that too. All machines now integrate seamlessly with each other, significantly speeding up the process of setting up automation. This update will be included when the game launches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576870/0e5e652fd6d94c49384251529aa4da23f8ff0a9a.jpg[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] these pictures are not of the game as it will be released. they are just a prototype of the current update. I am open to players' ideas and I can make corrections.
